# 3PL vendor requirements (approved by Priya, Feb 2026)

A vendor must meet ALL of these:

1. Uptime SLA of at least 99.9% for the warehouse management system.
2. Coverage of our East Coast distribution region.
3. Onboarding completed in 6 weeks or less (we need to be live before our Q2 peak).

Compare vendors on **total first-year cost** = (monthly fee × 12) + one-time onboarding fee.
